summary: Verified all 3 wired-up features end-to-end (backend + frontend): Movement Pack, Shared Doc Alerts (unseen badge), and Fuel Economy Leaderboard. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed. Frontend: Playwright verified data-testids and UI states across /movements, sidebar badge on Office, and Fleet > Fuel & Emissions leaderboard.

issues: Task description says 'Office → Fuel tab' but Fuel & Emissions actually lives under Fleet (Vehicles.js). Just a doc mismatch — feature works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6873 lines — should be split into modules per resource for maintainability (existing debt, not from this iteration).

FuelInput has no strict positivity/coherence validation (e.g. odometer monotonic per vehicle) — currently _enrich_fuel skips MPG when odometer decreases which is safe, but consider surfacing validation errors.
seed_data_creation: 3 movements (TEST-MV1/2, GMR-T1/T2/T3), 1 admin global-doc (TEST_UIBadge_*, TEST_SharedDoc), 2 vehicles (TEST-FV1/2) and 4 diesel fuel fills seeded via API. Leaderboard shows TEST-FV1 rank 1 (72.7 mpg, Most Efficient badge) and TEST-FV2 rank 2 (18.2 mpg).
